title: Genetic architecture and inheritance patterns of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy among 419 Chinese pedigrees carrying the ND4 11778G>A mutation.
intervention: m.11778G>A mutation (genetic architecture analysis; no pharmacological intervention reported)

outcomes.name: disease penetrance in maternally inherited families (haplogroup enrichment)
outcomes.effect_text: Haplogroups D4j, M7, M9, and M10 are significantly enriched in maternally inherited families with elevated disease penetrance

outcomes.name: transmission pattern (sporadic vs maternal inheritance)
outcomes.effect_text: 209 pedigrees contain only single affected individuals, which suggests that the m.11778G>A mutation alone fails to cause disease
